title: New dynamic
content: So the other night I had an update on a reoccurring Dream. This dream series is a little more rugged then a typical mall. In this dreamworld their is a monorail system that connect regional centers. These regional centers are very minimal. Every one except the old, sick, school students, or disabled live outdoors in tents or makeshift temporary camps or people sleep in giant sleeping halls with bathrooms and washrooms. On this planet there is generally always fresh fruits and veggies and lots of ways to get protein so farming was a new concept in this world, also people in this world like the nomadic lifestyle and prefer walking everywhere. Also everyone in this world is a hermaphrodite and generally travel with the kids they gave birth to. Now time for the update, the other night I traveled with my current partner in this world to space launch 6. We took the .monorail across the ocean to another continent to the launch tower and saw her go into space. She just got a job working on a colony as an agricultural administrator, she also took her 4 oldest kids with her and her 3 youngest stayed with my family clan. We stayed in this metro for a few weeks to try different food from various regions and decided that our next adventure is in a southern region of an island off the cost on one of the continents. Stay tuned.
